findings.claim: Suppressing analyzer diagnostics for members of metadata-only referenced types is deliberate product behavior, not an unintended loss of diagnostics; the defining assembly owns their validation, as the accompanying documentation states.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed, receive no member diagnostics from the consuming assembly, and are validated by their defining assembly.
